question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, egress 205.188.204.187
request.body: a JSON-RPC tools/list with empty params, sent with no session id and with no initialize in this request chain; and, as a second request, a JSON-RPC resources/list with empty params

decoded.tools: Three: search_mintlify (605-character description, inputSchema query required and language optional, readOnlyHint true), query_docs_filesystem_mintlify (3,864-character description, a single required command string, readOnlyHint true) and submit_feedback (313 characters, path and feedback both required, readOnlyHint FALSE, idempotentHint false, openWorldHint true). The two search parameters match the vendor's page, which says a version parameter appears only on sites that have versions: this site has languages and no versions, and the schema carries language and no version.
decoded.resources: A second request, resources/list, answered 200 with 829 bytes and three text/markdown resources: mintlify://skills/mintlify, mintlify://skills/mintlify-api and mintlify://skills/mintlify-docs. decoded.submit_feedback-not-called: Deliberately not called. Its annotation says it is not read-only and the vendor's page says it 'records as unhelpful feedback in your analytics dashboard', so calling it keyless would write a row into a third party's dashboard. Its presence and its annotations are read from the list; nothing is claimed about what calling it would do beyond the vendor's own sentence.

finding: A keyless tools/list to https://www.mintlify.com/docs/mcp on 2026-10-06 at 06:27Z, sent with no session id and no preceding initialize, answered 200 with three tools: two read-only retrieval tools and submit_feedback, annotated readOnlyHint false and openWorldHint true, which the vendor's page says records feedback into the site owner's analytics dashboard. So the write-capable tool on a public Mintlify site is reachable without an account. It was not called. A second request, resources/list, returned three skill.md resources as text/markdown.
